cases.message: @filter on an automation takes one string or an expression
cases.note: The only refusal a trigger filter has today is its form. The expression inside is captured verbatim and never parsed at load -- a trailing `||`, `and`, a single `=`, a field without its payload. prefix and the retired year() all load, and are decided by the runtime string evaluator when the event fires, which the expression epic (dsl-v1-expressions) retires.
